test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Unselfish interest in the welfare of others
solution:
The correct answer is: **Altruism.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Altruism** means unselfish concern for other people's happiness and welfare.

 
 
• **Example -** *Politicians are not necessarily motivated by pure **altruism**.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that** 'Altruism'** can be used as a one-word substitute for **'Unselfish interest in the welfare of others.'**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Celibacy** means the state of abstaining from marriage and sexual relations.
 
• **Misanthropy** means hatred or distrust of humankind.
 
• **Egoism** is an ethical theory that treats self-interest as the foundation of morality.
